Name: DPS Truffle Foxes - Custom Animal
Author: DPitSimp
Description:
[b]Special thanks to the Stardew Valley Discord server---This mod wouldn't be possible without numerous people's help from the mod help channels


[/b]I am happy to bring you guys something I drew myself. These foxes are a separate entity from pigs, [s]but [b]if you install the Pig-to-Fox dependent version[/b], be warned your pigs will also sound like foxes. At this moment I am unable to integrate the fox sound into my mod as a new sound effect because I am too unknowledgeable in the matters of modding.[/s] [b]Thanks to o0MrPro who let me integrate their fox sound into the mod![/b]   [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12755?tab=description]PigToFox Sound
[/url]Thanks to [url=http://next.nexusmods.com/profile/silvermoonchan/about-me]silvermoonchan[/url] for showing me how to integrate the sound!

The foxes cost 18,000 gold, which is 2,000 more than pigs but I needed to balance it considering they will [b]start digging truffles upon purchase!
[/b][i](this is just a positive way of saying I don't want to go through the torture of drawing another sprite sheet)
[/i]
The main file is the one that includes fox sound. An alternate version is offered if you don't prefer foxes that yap your ear off. [b]Only install one or the other[/b], if you have both installed your fox sprites will become walking error symbols

Manifest.Name: (CP) Truffle Foxes
Manifest.Description: Creates a grown fox that is ready to dig up truffles
